target.title: fix(exec): memoize duplicate auto-review verdicts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102249.

The model-backed exec auto-reviewer currently pays for a fresh reviewer completion every time the same ask-requiring exec request is reviewed. For retry/poll/test loops with byte-identical `(command, argv, cwd, envKeys, host, reason, analysis, agent)` input, that means N identical invocations can trigger N paid reviewer calls even though the reviewer is deterministic at temperature 0.

## Solution

Add a small per-reviewer-instance memo for exec reviewer decisions:

- identical review inputs reuse the same in-flight/completed decision
- changed request tuples still get a fresh model review
- the memo is capped at 128 entries to avoid unbounded growth in long runs
- approval semantics do not broaden: cached `allow-once` remains single-use at the exec host, and cached `ask` remains conservative human-review fallback

## Evidence

Validation run locally after rebasing onto `upstream/main`:

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/exec-auto-reviewer.test.ts` -> 1 file, 14 tests passed
- `pnpm tsgo:prod` -> passed
- `pnpm check:test-types` -> passed before rebase; no conflicts during rebase
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/agents/exec-auto-reviewer.ts src/agents/exec-auto-reviewer.test.ts` -> passed
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/agents/exec-auto-reviewer.ts src/agents/exec-auto-reviewer.test.ts` -> passed before rebase; no conflicts during rebase
- `git diff --check` -> passed

## Impact

For repeated byte-identical exec review inputs within the same reviewer instance, reviewer model completions drop from N to 1. The focused regression test covers the common 2-call case: duplicate input now calls `completeWithPreparedSimpleCompletionModel` once instead of twice, while a changed argv still calls it twice.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
